name: Waverly
install: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.3.10"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; bun install

terminals.name: website
terminals.description: Astro dev server for apps/website on http://localhost:4321
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd apps/website && ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=1 ./node_modules/.bin/astro dev --host --port 4321

terminals.name: docs
terminals.description: Astro dev server for apps/docs on http://localhost:4322
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd apps/docs && ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=1 ./node_modules/.bin/astro dev --host --port 4322
